meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先复现你报的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷,在临时克隆里写最小修复并跑通修复前后测试,最后交付:上游 openai/codex 走 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷则提一个内嵌补丁的 issue(绝不开 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求修复或调试 LazyCodex、Codex 的 bug,或为 bug 提 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修这个 Codex CLI 的 bug,并向上游提 PR
say.note: 会复现、修复,fork 后提 PR

say.text: 修复 LazyCodex 的这个缺陷
say.note: 在临时克隆里改并开一个验证过的 issue

say.text: 先复现这个 bug,再给我最小修复的补丁
say.note: 会给出补丁 diff 和前后日志

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces the LazyCodex or Codex bug, writes the smallest fix in a temp clone, runs before/after tests, then delivers a fork PR for upstream openai/codex, or a patch-embedded issue for LazyCodex bugs (never a PR there).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix or debug a LazyCodex or Codex bug, or to open a PR for a bug.

say_en.text: Fix this Codex CLI bug and open an upstream PR

say_en.note: Patches in a temp clone, opens a verified-fix issue

say_en.text: Reproduce this bug first, then give me the smallest patch
say_en.note: Outputs patch diff plus before/after logs
